001package com.streamconverter.web;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
009import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
010import com.streamConverter.path.TreePath;
011
012import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
013import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.util.List;
016import org.slf4j.Logger;
017import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
018import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBuffer;
019import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DefaultDataBufferFactory;
020import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
021import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
022import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
023import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
024import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
025import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
026
027/**
028 * Web API controller for StreamConverter processing.
029 *
030 * <p>Provides REST endpoints to process data streams using existing StreamConverter functionality.
031 */
032@RestController
033@RequestMapping("/api/v1/stream")
034public class StreamProcessingController {
035
036  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamProcessingController.class);
037
038  /**
039   * Process data stream with CSV extraction.
040   *
041   * @param inputData binary input data
042   * @param columnName CSV column name to extract
043   * @return processed data as binary stream
044   */
045  @PostMapping(
046      value = "/csv/extract",
047      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
048      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
049  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processCsvExtraction(
050      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String columnName) {
051
052    log.info("Processing CSV extraction for column: {}", columnName);
053
054    return inputData
055        .collectList()
056        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
057        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath(columnName), new PassThroughRule())))
058        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
059        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Process data stream with JSON path extraction.
064   *
065   * @param inputData binary input data
066   * @param jsonPath JSON path expression
067   * @return processed data as binary stream
068   */
069  @PostMapping(
070      value = "/json/extract",
071      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
072      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
073  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processJsonExtraction(
074      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String jsonPath) {
075
076    log.info("Processing JSON extraction for path: {}", jsonPath);
077
078    return inputData
079        .collectList()
080        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
081        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson(jsonPath), new PassThroughRule())))
082        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
083        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Process data stream with custom command pipeline.
088   *
089   * @param inputData binary input data
090   * @param pipelineConfig pipeline configuration header
091   * @return processed data as binary stream
092   */
093  @PostMapping(
094      value = "/process",
095      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
096      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
097  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processWithPipeline(
098      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData,
099      @RequestHeader("X-Pipeline-Config") String pipelineConfig) {
100
101    log.info("Processing with pipeline config: {}", pipelineConfig);
102
103    return inputData
104        .collectList()
105        .map(this::combineDataBuffers)
106        .map(data -> processWithStreamConverter(data, buildPipelineFromConfig(pipelineConfig)))
107        .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(createDataBufferFlux(result)))
108        .onErrorReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
109  }
110
111  /**
112   * Health check endpoint.
113   *
114   * @return simple health status
115   */
116  @GetMapping("/health")
117  public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
118    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("StreamConverter Web API is running"));
119  }
120
121  /**
122   * Combines multiple DataBuffer objects into a single byte array.
123   *
124   * @param dataBuffers list of data buffers
125   * @return combined byte array
126   */
127  private byte[] combineDataBuffers(List<DataBuffer> dataBuffers) {
128    try (ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
129      for (DataBuffer buffer : dataBuffers) {
130        byte[] bytes = new byte[buffer.readableByteCount()];
131        buffer.read(bytes);
132        outputStream.write(bytes);
133      }
134      return outputStream.toByteArray();
135    } catch (IOException e) {
136      log.error("Error combining data buffers", e);
137      throw new RuntimeException("Failed to combine input data", e);
138    }
139  }
140
141  /**
142   * Processes data using StreamConverter with given commands.
143   *
144   * @param inputData input byte array
145   * @param commands stream commands to execute
146   * @return processed output byte array
147   */
148  private byte[] processWithStreamConverter(byte[] inputData, IStreamCommand... commands) {
149    try (ByteArrayInputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData);
150        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
151
152      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(commands);
153      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
154
155      return outputStream.toByteArray();
156
157    } catch (IOException e) {
158      log.error("Error processing with StreamConverter", e);
159      throw new RuntimeException("Stream processing failed", e);
160    }
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * Creates a Flux of DataBuffer from byte array.
165   *
166   * @param data byte array to convert
167   * @return Flux of DataBuffer
168   */
169  private Flux<DataBuffer> createDataBufferFlux(byte[] data) {
170    DataBuffer buffer = new DefaultDataBufferFactory().wrap(data);
171    return Flux.just(buffer);
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Builds a pipeline from configuration string.
176   *
177   * @param config pipeline configuration (e.g., "csv:name,json:$.result,process:validator")
178   * @return array of stream commands
179   */
180  private IStreamCommand[] buildPipelineFromConfig(String config) {
181    String[] commandConfigs = config.split(",");
182    IStreamCommand[] commands = new IStreamCommand[commandConfigs.length];
183
184    for (int i = 0; i < commandConfigs.length; i++) {
185      String[] parts = commandConfigs[i].split(":", 2);
186      String commandType = parts[0].trim();
187      String parameter = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].trim() : "";
188
189      commands[i] =
190          switch (commandType.toLowerCase()) {
191            case "csv" -> CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
192            case "json" -> JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
193            case "process" -> new SampleStreamCommand(parameter);
194            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown command type: " + commandType);
195          };
196    }
197
198    log.info("Built pipeline with {} commands", commands.length);
199    return commands;
200  }
201}
